title: Oxone®-mediated Dakin-like reaction to synthesize hydroxyarenes: an approach using pyrazolo[1,5-a]pyrimidines
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,23441-23447
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02812D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Carlos Cifuentes, Marianna Cubides, Jaime Portilla
An Oxone®-mediated reaction of formyl(hetero)arenes to synthesize hydroxylated (hetero)arenes was presented, along with the synthetic applications of some selected products. Products bear typical fluorophores and the pyrazolo[1,5-a]pyrimidine core.
